preconditions.description: The number of elements in the sequence is between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element in the sequence is between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The length of the final sequence is k.

postconditions.expression: all(final_sequence[i] == a[i] for i in range(len(final_sequence)) if i < len(a) and a[i] != a[i+1])
postconditions.description: Elements in the final sequence remain unchanged if they were not part of a consecutive pair in the original sequence.

postconditions.expression: all(final_sequence[i] == a[i] + 1 for i in range(len(final_sequence)) if i < len(a) - 1 and a[i] == a[i+1])
postconditions.description: Consecutive equal elements in the original sequence are replaced by a single incremented element in the final sequence.

postconditions.expression: all(final_sequence[i] != final_sequence[i+1] for i in range(len(final_sequence) - 1))
postconditions.description: There are no consecutive equal elements in the final sequence.
